exposure: Pediatric thyroid nodule classification (AUS/FLUS, SFN, Bethesda 3/4)
outcome: Postoperative histopathological classification of thyroid nodules (benign, low-risk, malignant neoplasms)
cohort: Forty-four pediatric patients at a single center with thyroid nodules classified as AUS/FLUS or SFN who underwent surgical intervention.
finding: EU-TIRADS 5 scores were frequently observed in histologically benign cases, potentially leading to unnecessary biopsies, while higher EU-TIRADS scores positively correlated with malignancy risk, especially in Bethesda 4 cases.
